0022600179.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (3-4, winners of three straight) host the Utah Jazz (1-6, losers of five straight) in their eighth game of the season, with the Pelicans 2-2 at home and the Jazz 1-4 on the road. New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Mo Bamba is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. The Pelicans trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 120-119 loss in Salt Lake City on October 23, following a 3-0 sweep of Utah in 2025-26.
